# `@slintlu` API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-api-docs.py from src/ui; do not edit by hand. -->

```slint
import { PanelWindow, Shell, Clock, Theme } from "@slintlu";
```

Globals are filled in by SlintLu; *read* properties are set by the runtime, *read / write*
ones may also be assigned by the shell, and callbacks are implemented natively.

## Window components

### FloatingWindow (inherits `Window`)

An ordinary application window (settings, dialogs …), shown once.

| Member | Type | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `app-id` | `string` | set = `"slintlu"` | The app id reported to the compositor (for window rules). |

### LockWindow (inherits `Window`)

A lock screen. While the session is locked (see `Session.lock()`), one instance covers every screen and receives all input. Call `Session.authenticate(password)` to unlock.

### PanelWindow (inherits `Window`)

A wlr-layer-shell surface: bars, docks, wallpapers, overlays, notifications …  One instance is created per screen (restrict with `show-on`). Set its size with `preferred-width` / `preferred-height` or let the layout decide; axes anchored on both sides are stretched by the compositor.

| Member | Type | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `layer` | `Layer` | set = `Layer.top` | Stacking layer: background (wallpapers), bottom, top (bars) or overlay (launchers, OSDs). |
| `namespace` | `string` | set = `"slintlu"` | Namespace reported to the compositor, e.g. for layer rules. |
| `anchor-top` | `bool` | set | Screen edges to attach to. Anchoring opposite edges stretches the panel; no anchors centre it. |
| `anchor-bottom` | `bool` | set |  |
| `anchor-left` | `bool` | set |  |
| `anchor-right` | `bool` | set |  |
| `exclusive-mode` | `ExclusiveMode` | set = `ExclusiveMode.auto` | How much space other windows leave for the panel. |
| `exclusive-zone` | `length` | set = `0px` | Used when `exclusive-mode` is `fixed`. |
| `margin-top` | `length` | set = `0px` | Distance from the anchored edges. |
| `margin-right` | `length` | set = `0px` |  |
| `margin-bottom` | `length` | set = `0px` |  |
| `margin-left` | `length` | set = `0px` |  |
| `keyboard-mode` | `KeyboardMode` | set = `KeyboardMode.none` | Whether the panel can take keyboard focus. |
| `show-on` | `[string]` | set = `[]` | Connector names of the screens to appear on, e.g. ["DP-1"]. Empty means all screens. |
| `shown` | `bool` | set = `true` | Whether the panel is mapped. Toggle it to build popups, menus and drawers. |

## Globals

### Apps

|---|---|---|---|
| `all` | `[AppInfo]` | read | Every visible application, sorted by name. |
| `search(query: string, limit: int)` | callback → `[AppInfo]` | call | Fuzzy search over names, descriptions and keywords, frequently used apps first. An empty query lists the most used applications. |
| `launch(id: string)` | callback | call |  |
| `launch-action(id: string, action: string)` | callback | call | Runs one of the application's extra actions (e.g. "new-private-window"). |

### Clock

The local time, updated every second.

| Member | Type | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `time` | `string` | read | Formatted with `time-format` / `date-format`. |
| `date` | `string` | read |  |
| `hour` | `int` | read |  |
| `minute` | `int` | read |  |
| `second` | `int` | read |  |
| `year` | `int` | read |  |
| `month` | `int` | read |  |
| `day` | `int` | read |  |
| `weekday` | `int` | read | 1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday. |
| `time-format` | `string` | read / write = `"%H:%M"` | strftime patterns (https://docs.rs/chrono/latest/chrono/format/strftime). Change them in an `init` handler, e.g. `init => { Clock.time-format = "%H:%M:%S"; }`. |
| `date-format` | `string` | read / write = `"%a %e %b"` |  |
| `month-grid(year: int, month: int, monday-first: bool)` | callback → `[CalendarDay]` | call | Six weeks (42 days) covering a month, for calendar grids. |
| `format-date(year: int, month: int, day: int, pattern: string)` | callback → `string` | call | Formats a date with a strftime pattern, e.g. format-date(2026, 10, 1, "%B %Y"). |

### Compositor

The compositor itself: its name, requests it sends to the shell (keyboard shortcuts that open shell UI) and compositor-specific commands.

| Member | Type | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | read | "lunadash", "niri", "hyprland", "sway", … or "unknown". |
| `request` | `string` | read | The latest request, e.g. "launcher" (argument "true"/"false"), "settings" (argument: the page), "wallpaper-picker", "control-center", "clipboard", "power-menu". React to changes of `request-serial`. |
| `request-argument` | `string` | read |  |
| `request-serial` | `int` | read |  |
| `has-commands` | `bool` | read | Whether `command` is supported (LunaDash). |
| `command(method: string, value: string)` | callback | call | A compositor-specific command, e.g. command("launch-default", "terminal") on LunaDash. |

### Files

Directories and images, e.g. for a wallpaper picker.

| Member | Type | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `home` | `string` | read | The home directory; paths starting with "~" are expanded everywhere. |
| `revision` | `int` | read | Increases when thumbnails finish; pass it to `thumbnail` to show them as they appear. |
| `list(dir: string, extensions: string)` | callback → `[FileEntry]` | call | Entries of a directory, directories first. `extensions` filters files: "png,jpg,webp". |
| `exists(path: string)` | callback → `bool` | call |  |
| `image(path: string)` | callback → `image` | call | The image at a path (full size; use `thumbnail` for grids). |
| `thumbnail(path: string, size: int, revision: int)` | callback → `image` | call | A cached thumbnail of at most `size` pixels, generated in the background (empty until ready). |

### I18n

Translations. Put `<language>.po` files (e.g. from `slint-tr-extractor`) in an `i18n` directory next to your shell; texts written as `@tr("...")` are translated.

| Member | Type | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `language` | `string` | read | The active language, e.g. "de" or "zh_TW"; empty for the untranslated texts. |
| `languages` | `[string]` | read | Languages with a translation in the shell's `i18n` directory. |
| `set-language(language: string)` | callback | call | Switches the language at runtime ("" for untranslated texts). |

### Icons

Icons from the desktop's icon theme.

| Member | Type | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `theme` | `string` | read | The icon theme in use. |
| `lookup(name: string, size: int)` | callback → `image` | call | An icon by name (e.g. "firefox", "audio-volume-high") or path, at about `size` pixels. |

### Idle

User activity. Settings apply to the whole shell. React to `idle` with a local property and a `changed` handler, e.g. property <bool> idle: Idle.idle; changed idle => { if idle { Shell.exec("niri msg action power-off-monitors"); } }

| Member | Type | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `available` | `bool` | read | Whether idle detection works on this compositor (ext-idle-notify-v1). |
| `idle` | `bool` | read | No input for `timeout`. |
| `timeout` | `duration` | read = `300s` |  |
| `lock-after` | `duration` | read = `0s` | Lock the session after this much inactivity; 0 disables it. |
| `inhibited` | `bool` | read | The screen is kept awake (a "caffeine" toggle). Needs a visible shell window. |
| `set-timeout(timeout: duration)` | callback | call |  |
| `set-lock-after(timeout: duration)` | callback | call |  |
| `set-inhibited(inhibited: bool)` | callback | call |  |

### Polkit

The polkit authentication agent: show a dialog while `active` (e.g. a PanelWindow on the overlay layer with `keyboard-mode: exclusive` and `shown: Polkit.active`).

| Member | Type | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `available` | `bool` | read | SlintLu is the session's polkit agent (no other agent was registered). |
| `active` | `bool` | read | A request is waiting for the user. |
| `message` | `string` | read | Why authentication is needed, from the application. |
| `action-id` | `string` | read |  |
| `icon-name` | `string` | read |  |
| `user` | `string` | read | Whose password is asked for. |
| `prompt` | `string` | read | The helper's question, normally "Password: ". |
| `echo` | `bool` | read | Show what is typed (the question is not a password). |
| `error` | `string` | read | An error from the last attempt, e.g. "Authentication failed, please try again." |
| `authenticating` | `bool` | read | An answer is being checked. |
| `respond(text: string)` | callback | call | Answers the prompt. |
| `cancel()` | callback | call |  |

### Session

The session lock. Define a component inheriting `LockWindow` to enable locking.

| Member | Type | Access | Description |

| `authenticating` | `bool` | read | A password check is running. |
| `message` | `string` | read | Feedback for the lock screen, e.g. "Authentication failure". |
| `lock-before-sleep` | `bool` | read = `true` | Lock automatically before the machine suspends (see `set-lock-before-sleep`). |
| `lock()` | callback | call | Locks now (also triggered by `loginctl lock-session` and `Power.lock()`). |
| `authenticate(password: string)` | callback | call | Checks the password with PAM and unlocks on success. |
| `set-lock-before-sleep(enabled: bool)` | callback | call |  |

### Shared

State shared by all windows of the shell. Globals you define yourself exist once per window (one panel cannot see another panel's copy), so keep cross-window state — which popup is open, toggles — here: property <bool> open: Shared.get-bool("launcher", false, Shared.revision); clicked => { Shared.toggle("launcher"); } From scripts: `slintlu msg call Shared.toggle launcher`.

| Member | Type | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `revision` | `int` | read | Increases on every change; pass it to the getters. |
| `get-string(key: string, fallback: string, revision: int)` | callback → `string` | call |  |
| `get-number(key: string, fallback: float, revision: int)` | callback → `float` | call |  |
| `get-bool(key: string, fallback: bool, revision: int)` | callback → `bool` | call |  |
| `set-string(key: string, value: string)` | callback | call |  |
| `set-number(key: string, value: float)` | callback | call |  |
| `set-bool(key: string, value: bool)` | callback | call |  |
| `remove(key: string)` | callback | call |  |
| `toggle(key: string)` | callback | call | Flips a bool (false when unset). |

## Enums

### ExclusiveMode

How much space a panel reserves at the edge it is anchored to.

| Member | Type | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `auto` |  |  | Its own height (width for vertical panels) when anchored to one edge. |
| `normal` |  |  | Nothing, but other panels' zones are respected. |
| `ignore` |  |  | Nothing, and other panels' zones are ignored (wallpapers, overlays). |
| `fixed` |  |  | Exactly `exclusive-zone`. |

### KeyboardMode

How a panel receives keyboard focus.

| Member | Type | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `none` |  |  | Never (bars, wallpapers). |
| `exclusive` |  |  | Grabs the keyboard while visible (launchers, lock screens). |
| `on-demand` |  |  | When clicked, like a normal window. |

### Layer

Plain types shared by the SlintLu library. The layer-shell layer, from the bottom of the stack to the top.
